articles.title: Hackers exploited iOS and Android flaws to infect phones
articles.content: Researchers say group may have been Kremlin-sponsored in search of diplomatic targets.

articles.contentZh: 研究人员说，该组织可能是克里姆林宫为寻找外交目标而资助的。

articles.title: VMware releases vSphere Express for virtualization on up to 128 cores
articles.content: “We started listening to a lot of our lower-end customers," VMware exec says.

articles.content: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling, and fake job interviews.

articles.title: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
articles.content: UEFI bootkit BlackX exploits Microsoft's lack of clarity around Secure Boot protections.
articles.titleZh: UEFI bootkit感染了完全修补的Windows计算机。微软是罪魁祸首吗？
articles.contentZh: UEFI bootkit BlackX利用了微软在安全启动保护方面缺乏清晰的认识。

articles.title: X says its updated web app is way faster
articles.content: X is introducing a new version of its web app that it says is much faster than before, and it's now rolling out the updated app "one country at a time" for signed-in users. "Open a profile on X.com over a slow connection," principal engineer Yagiz Nizipli said in a blog post about the changes. […]
articles.titleZh: X表示其更新的网络应用程序速度更快
articles.contentZh: X正在推出一个新版本的网络应用程序，它说比以前快得多，现在它正在为登录用户推出更新的应用程序“一次一个国家”。“通过慢速连接在X.com上打开个人资料，”首席工程师Yagiz Nizipli在一篇关于这些变化的博客文章中说。[…]
